messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Business Services and Partnerships" as it appears in the following examples.
['Эффективные техники продаж', 'I AND THE REST OF MY FAMILY HAVE DECIDED TO GIVE YOU 15% OF THE TOTAL SUM FOR YOUR KIND ASSISTANCE.', 'WE HAVE ALSO EVOLVED A SHARING FORMULA WHICH IS AS FOLLOWS:1) 35% FOR THE FOREIGN ACCOUNT OWNER) 5% IS SET ASIDE FOR ANY EXPENSES THAT MAY BE INCURRED BOTH AT LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL LEVEL. 3) 60% IS FOR ME.', 'Due to my financial status, I have decided to sell each kilo 4500 USD quite below the world market price.', 'When the proceeds in his bank account are paid to you, we would share the proceeds on a mutually agreed-upon percentage of 60% to me and 40% to your kind self.', 'Once the funds have been transferred to your nominated bank account we shall share in the ratio of 60% for me, 30% for you and 10% for any expenses incurred during the course of this operation.', "I am looking for a trustworthy individual/ firm by my client's instructions to receiving the funds and advising us in making the rightful investment as well as to provide account(s)where the funds will be lodged into.", 'The money will be paid into your account for us to share in the ratio of 60% for me and 35%[US$8,750,000:00 DOLLARS] for you then 5% will be set aside for any expenses that may occur during the transfer process.', 'After viewing our order please kindly send me a quote and include delivery terms, payment methods and terms and any further information you would need to give me by mail and I would call you on the number listed.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
